Name: Fix Museum Inventory
Author: CodeKokeshi
Description:
[center]Rewrote the vanilla museum inventory code to fix various issues like inventory UI covering the museum slots. Added a move button to move the inventory UI around and removed the inventory on the arrangement mode.

[b]WITH CONTROLLER SUPPORT[/b]

_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

[b]Disclaimer: [/b]Please report any issues with a detailed description in the comments or bug section. I am a total beginner to Stardew Valley and its modding scene. [b]When I created this mod, my in-game progress was Spring 12, Year 1.[/b]
